title: Exact Temasek 2070 versus CPF OA scenario audit
number_encoding: Financial values are exact strings: terminating decimals where possible, otherwise reduced numerator/denominator. Counts are integers. No float or rounding is used.

scope.entry_fx: User-provided USD/SGD 1.275, not independently asserted as an executable FX rate.
scope.purchase_price: User calculator input 50; uploaded ask 49.828 is shown in a separate case.
scope.principal_payment: Full contractual USD face amount, conditional on payment and the stated redemption scenario.
scope.first_par_call_scenario: Issuer calls all modeled holdings on 2070-04-06 at par; this is a scenario, not a prediction.
scope.maturity_scenario: Notes remain outstanding until 2070-10-06; no earlier make-whole, tax or other redemption, and no default.
scope.residual_cash: The main case keeps SGD271.25 as unchanged SGD cash; no interest is modeled on it.
scope.fees: Fees, FX spreads and other dealing costs are unknown and excluded. Residual cash is before those costs.
scope.coupons: Coupons are gross contractual cash receipts; no reinvestment return is modeled.
scope.first_coupon_accrual: The first USD3900 coupon includes USD650 of pre-purchase accrued interest already paid to the seller in the purchase cost. Post-purchase accrual within that first coupon is USD3250. Do not subtract the accrued interest again when the full dirty purchase cost is already deducted.
scope.estate: Ending estate comprises principal converted at terminal FX plus residual cash, with all coupons assumed spent for this measure.
scope.cashflow_plus_estate: Cumulative paid coupons plus ending estate is a nominal receipts summary, not terminal NAV when coupons have been spent and not an annualized return.
scope.business_days: Dated schedule shows contractual 6 April/6 October dates without calendar business-day adjustments.
scope.cpf: CPF benchmark is only SGD5000 annual base interest and SGD200000 preserved principal; precise cumulative CPF cashflows require withdrawal and interest-credit timing and are not fabricated.

formulas.coupon_cashflows_sgd: sum over payments of [semiannual coupon USD * FX at each coupon conversion]
formulas.average_fx_shortcut: Identical USD coupons imply cumulative SGD coupons = coupon count * semiannual USD coupon * arithmetic average conversion FX.
formulas.ending_estate_sgd: face USD * terminal FX + residual SGD
formulas.income_break_even_fx: CPF annual SGD5000 / annual coupon USD
formulas.clean_market_value_sgd: face USD * market clean price / 100 * FX
formulas.dirty_market_value_sgd: (face USD * market clean price / 100 + accrued USD on stated valuation/settlement date) * FX

optional_as_of_quote_date_accrual_inform.warning: This accrual date differs from the 6 November purchase/sale settlement illustration. Do not mix the two bases for a same-settlement P&L comparison.

separate_44_full_year_3_percent_annual_u.label: Separate analytical stress using the prior uploaded report's 3% annual USD weakening; 44 complete years
separate_44_full_year_3_percent_annual_u.warning: This uses 44 full years and the theoretical clean SGD200000 / price50 case. It is not the actual 6 November 2026 to 6 October 2070 settlement-to-maturity interval, nor the USD312000 practical-face case. The seven one-off FX levels are not assumed to bound decades of FX movements.
separate_44_full_year_3_percent_annual_u.bound_explanation: Halving depreciation has an exact algebraic expression and a non-terminating decimal. Numerical values supplied here are strict rational bounds, not rounded point estimates.

checks: No floating-point values or decimal rounding.
Cost, accrued interest and residual reconcile exactly to SGD200000.
Practical lots meet USD250000 minimum and USD1000 increments; next denominations exceed the budget before fees.
Schedule has 88 strictly increasing contractual coupon dates, 87 in the first-par-call subset.
Coupon and principal totals independently sum from the dated schedule.
All seven same-FX heatmap diagonal values reconcile with scenario-row totals.
Base values and alternating-path cashflows match independent arithmetic assertions.
Same-settlement dirty-sale change reconciles exactly with clean-price P&L.
